title: ISM-SCS Vendor Capture & Rating Schema
description: The bucket. Every vendor/target enters through this schema; every score is computed from evidence-linked dimension ratings, never assigned directly. Derived from the founder's outreach.py template (TargetCompany / OutreachPackage), hardened: no placeholder contacts, no un-sourced scores.

sector.description: e.g. 'Amorphous alloys / magnetic cores', 'CAL / volumetric printing', 'CNT & aerogel integration', 'Photopolymer resins', 'Micro-coil / toroid fabrication'

email.description: Real published address, or null ONLY when status=candidate and the vendor publishes no email (contact form only, source_url required). '.example'/placeholder domains are rejected by the validator.

email_verified.description: True only when the address was read from the company's own site/datasheet, not a directory scrape.

FitRating.description: fit_score is COMPUTED: weighted mean of the five dimensions. Each dimension requires an evidence URL. Weights fixed here so scores are comparable across the bucket.

capability_match.description: weight 0.35 — do they actually do the process we need (closed micro-toroids, acoustophoretic alignment, 2D projection litho, pyrolysis...)

scale_fit.description: weight 0.20 — can they work at our scale (100 um cores, 50 mm tiles, prototype quantities) vs only industrial volume

materials_access.description: weight 0.20 — do they stock/process the actual alloys & resins (2714A, 2605SA1, CNT photopolymers)

evidence_quality.description: weight 0.15 — datasheets & published specs vs marketing claims

reachability.description: weight 0.10 — a named, verified engineering contact vs a web form

OutreachPackage.description: Generated per rated target. Draft only — sending requires the founder's tap (standing veto). The patent paragraph from the original template is EXCLUDED from generated packages until counsel-grade review; novelty claims are not outreach copy.
